You are working the **Nxeon board** Ideas cards in the Nxeon platform repo at /opt/nxeon (Next.js App Router + Prisma + Tailwind, this box). 

## Non-negotiable workflow rule (the board is a living record)
For EACH card: FIRST move it Ideas → In progress and post a comment that you're starting; when done, move it to Review (or Done if fully verified) and post a comment documenting what you changed + any follow-ups. Mechanics — write a small script in /opt/nxeon and run with `node` (import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client"; const db = new PrismaClient()):
- move:   `await db.card.update({ where:{ id }, data:{ columnId, position: 0 } })`
- comment:`await db.cardComment.create({ data:{ cardId: id, authorName: "Claude", body } })`
Column IDs (Nxeon board): In progress = `cmsavdblw000bhla47dqv2n1d`, Review = `cmsavdblw000chla4g6fdjg8h`, Done = `cmsavdblw000dhla4dfb3n79h`.

## The 4 cards
1. **Responsive Mobile Fix** (id `cmsf1wrqn0003hln5lu9ox2zx`) — "on mobile this animation keeps changing the page, fix it." There's a video attachment at /opt/nxeon/board-uploads (filename contains "responsive fix") you can't watch, so investigate: on small screens some marketing animation causes the page to jump/scroll/navigate. Likely culprits: a horizontal scroll/scroll-snap/marquee, a transform/parallax that overflows and creates horizontal scroll, or scroll-jacking. Audit the homepage + marketing components (components/marketing/*, the Reveal component, any carousel/marquee/animated hero). Fix so mobile doesn't get unwanted page movement: prevent horizontal overflow (overflow-x-hidden where appropriate), disable/þreduce the offending animation under `sm`, and respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. Make a targeted, defensible fix.
2. **Resize > Upgrade** (id `cmsf2rsop000fhln5jz0vjern`) — rename the customer-facing "Resize" server action to "Upgrade" everywhere the CUSTOMER sees it (buttons, headings, tab labels, toasts). Only user-facing COPY — do NOT rename functions/routes/API/Prisma fields (that would break things). Search components/ and app/ for "Resize"/"resize" in the server UI.
3. **Backups** (id `cmsf2rwhi000hhln5dcmaj09e`) — three things: (a) add a way for customers to DOWNLOAD a backup; (b) when a customer runs a manual backup, do NOT expose internal infra detail like "4TB backup pool" (that's private company info — remove/replace that copy); (c) confirm whether AUTOMATED backups are actually working (read the "Backups not working" card in the Done column for context — find it via Prisma by title on board `cmsavdblr0008hla4pygic72o`). Investigate the backups UI + the backup server action(s).
4. **Sitemap** (id `cmsf2vkhx000jhln5gx12v0l3`) — the blog now has ~313 published posts. Make sure the sitemap (check app/sitemap.ts and/or a sitemap route) includes ALL published blog posts (and the new marketing/landing pages) so Google Search Console can index them. If the sitemap is static or missing blog URLs, make it dynamic from the DB.

## Rules
- After each card's code changes: `npx tsc --noEmit` must stay clean; run `npm run build` at the end to confirm the whole thing compiles.
- COMMIT your work (git add -A && git commit -m "..."; the post-commit hook pushes to GitHub). Do NOT run scripts/promote-production.sh or scripts/deploy-staging.sh — production deploy is handled separately by the user. Just leave committed code on main.
- Delete any throwaway scripts you create (the _*.mjs helpers) before finishing, but KEEP real code changes.
- If a card is genuinely too ambiguous to finish (e.g. the mobile fix without the video), do your best defensible fix, move it to Review, and note in the comment exactly what you changed and what to verify.

Report back: per-card, what you changed, the card's final column, and the commit hash(es). Confirm tsc + build are clean.

**Card 1 — Responsive Mobile Fix** (→ Review, commit `2949ce7`)
Extracted frames from the attached video with ffmpeg to identify the culprit: the homepage hero **DeployStage** card (`components/marketing/DeployStage.tsx`). Its "live" footer (the web-prod-01 row) animated `max-h-0` → `max-h-24` each loop, so the card grew/shrank on every cycle and shoved the stat bar below it up and down — reads as the whole page jumping on mobile where sections stack. Fix: always render the footer so it permanently reserves its height; only fade its visibility. Card height is now constant across the loop. `prefers-reduced-motion` already short-circuits to the finished state.

**Card 2 — Resize → Upgrade** (→ Review, commit `ef8d99e`)
Copy-only rename in `ServerTabs.tsx` (tab now "Upgrade" via a label override — internal key stays `resize` so `?tab=resize` deep-links, panels map and job types keep working), `ResizePicker.tsx` (button/confirm/helper text), `MigrationWizard.tsx`, `ReinstallOs.tsx`. `ActivityTimeline` RESIZE label → "Plan changed" (accurate — downgrades also log `RESIZE`). No functions/routes/API/Prisma names touched. `ResizeDown` already read "Downsize". Marketing feature copy left alone (bidirectional capability, not the server-action button).

**Card 3 — Backups** (→ Review, commit `9c6bde7`)
(a) New secure download route `app/api/servers/[serverId]/backups/download` — streams the vzdump archive with two guards: session-user ownership AND volid-in-`listBackups(server.vmid)` (same tenancy check as restore), path confined to the dump dir, rate-limited, streamed not buffered. Added a Download button per row in `BackupRestore.tsx`; helper `backupDumpDir()` in `lib/proxmox.ts`. (b) Removed the "4 TB pool"/"backup pool" internal detail from customer copy (page.tsx, BackupSchedule, and the live progress step). (c) Confirmed automated backups ARE wired end-to-end: `worker/index.ts:1326` runs `scheduledBackupSweep()` every 15 min → `BACKUP_CREATE` jobs → `lastAutoBackup` stamped only on proof. **Finding:** `Server.autoBackup` defaults `false`, so per-server schedules are opt-in; new servers rely on the platform-wide nightly DR backup until enabled — flagged for a product decision, not changed unilaterally.

**Card 4 — Sitemap** (→ Review, commit `31f8c0a`)
